newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher explores French takeover - report.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher explores French takeover - report.

text.p: Kingfisher Plc is exploring a possible takeover this year of French furniture and electricals retailer BUT, in which it has a 20 percent stake, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.

The FT, which did not cite the source of the report, said a bid for control of the second largest furniture chain and fourth largest electricals group in France could cost up to 300 million stg ($505 million).
"Although no decision has been taken, Kingfisher is looking into unwinding an agreement which states it should wait until March 1998 before making any offer," the report said.
The FT said Kingfisher bought the 20 percent stake for 59 million ($99.2 million) a year ago.
